worlds_patch_evidence: Official 26.20 notes subtitle: 'the Worlds patch is here!'; lead paragraph: 'For Summoner's Rift, this is the patch we'll be seeing our year-defining competitive play on.' 26.19 notes: 'We're soon coming up on the Worlds patch (which is the patch after this one)'.
notes: Riot's patch notes do not label each champion buff/nerf/adjust in a header. label_source='official' means Riot's blurb or intro explicitly uses buff/nerf/adjust for that champion's change in that patch; 'inferred' means the direction was decided from the numbers and the blurb's stated intent (see 'note' on each change).
date = publication date on the notes page (18:00 UTC); live_date = the day the patch went live on servers (LoL wiki).

Secondary cross-check: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V26.18, V26.19, V26.20 (accessed 15/10/2026). Where the wiki disagrees with the official text (Cassiopeia E damage 26.18, Syndra splinter mana 26.18, Tahm Kench Q old value 26.20, Aurora Realm Hopper 26.19) the official text is used and the disagreement is recorded in the note.
Only Summoner's Rift changes are recorded. Classic, ARAM Mayhem and Arena changes are excluded (see 'excluded' per patch).

patches.riot_intro: Bee wee woop - it's time for WORLDS! For Summoner's Rift, this is the patch we'll be seeing our year-defining competitive play on.

changes.name: Ambessa
changes.summary: Passive damage 5-30 (+25% bonus AD) to 5-25 (+20% bonus AD)
details: Passive - Drakehound's Step: Damage 5 - 30 (+25% bonus AD) to 5 - 25 (+20% bonus AD)
changes.note: Riot's intro calls this an 'adjustment to a pro staple'; all numbers go down, so recorded as nerf. Blurb: 'too reliable in her late game output ... especially pro-play'.

changes.name: Ashe
changes.summary: AD per level 3.5 to 3
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage per level 3.5 to 3
changes.note: Blurb: 'premier marksman in pro play ... too much raw damage'.

changes.name: Cassiopeia
changes.summary: Base health 630 to 610; base mana 480 to 450
details: Base Stats: Health 630 to 610
Base Stats: Mana 480 to 450
changes.note: Blurb: 'another swing at her early resources because of how dominant she still is in early laning'. Follow-up to the 26.18 adjustment.

changes.name: Diana
changes.summary: W shield bonus health ratio 11% to 14%
details: W - Pale Cascade: Shield Bonus Health Ratio 11% to 14%
changes.note: Blurb: bruiser builds lagging, 'inject a bit more power into that playstyle'.

changes.name: Kennen
details: E - Lightning Rush: Bonus Attack Speed 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80% to 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90%
changes.note: Intro paragraph: 'buffs to weaker champions who might be on the edge of viability like Kennen & Kindred'. Also offsets the Rocketbelt change.

changes.name: Kindred
changes.summary: W monster mod 150% to 165%; E slow 1s to 1.5s; E no longer targets small monsters
details: W - Wolf's Frenzy: Monster Mod 150% to 165%
E - Mounting Dread: Slow Duration 1s to 1.5s
E - Mounting Dread: Small Monster Targeting Enabled to Removed
changes.note: Blurb: 'Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs'.

changes.name: K'Sante
changes.summary: W mana cost 40/45/50/55/60 to 45/50/55/60/65; W damage reduction 30/75% to 25/70%
details: W - Path Maker: Mana Cost 40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60 to 45 / 50 / 55 / 60 / 65
W - Path Maker: Damage Reduction (base / All Out) 30 / 75% to 25 / 70%
changes.note: Riot's intro calls this an 'adjustment to a pro staple'; all numbers go down, so recorded as nerf. Blurb: 'Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play'.

changes.name: Lillia
changes.summary: R sleep duration 2.5s to 2.5/2.75/3s
details: R - Lilting Lullaby: Sleep Duration 2.5s to 2.5 / 2.75 / 3s
changes.note: Blurb: 'following up with another buff' (second consecutive Lillia buff after 26.19).

changes.name: Lucian
changes.summary: AD per level 2.5 to 2.9
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage 60 + 2.5/Level to 60 + 2.9/Level
changes.note: Blurb: 26.19 passive change 'landed as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff'.

changes.name: Mordekaiser
changes.summary: Q level 10-20 scaling +5/lvl to +7/lvl; R cooldown 140/120/100s to 120/110/100s
details: Q - Obliterate: Scaling Level 10-20 (+5/lvl) to (+7/lvl)
R - Realm of Death: Cooldown 140 / 120 / 100s to 120 / 110 / 100s
changes.note: Blurb: ultimate windows too long, Q 'can do more damage later on'.

changes.name: Neeko
details: E - Tangle-Barbs: Empowered Root Duration 1.8 / 2.1 / 2.4 / 2.7 / 3s to 2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3s
changes.note: Blurb: compensation for the Rocketbelt change ('will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko').

changes.name: Smolder
changes.summary: Passive Super Scorcher bonus magic damage 25-55% (+0-9% with IE) to 25-60% (+0-10.5% with IE); Flap Flap Flap 8-12.8% (+0-1.44% with IE) to 8-14% (+0-1.8% with IE); R self heal 100/135/170 (+50% bonus AD) to 100/175/250 (+75% bonus AD)
details: Passive - Dragon Practice: Super Scorcher Bonus Magic Damage 25 - 55% (+0-9% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks to 25 - 60% (+0-10.5% with IE)
Passive - Dragon Practice: Flap Flap Flap Bonus Magic Damage 8 - 12.8% (+0-1.44% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks to 8 - 14% (+0-1.8% with IE)
R - MMOOOMMMM!: Self Heal 100 / 135 / 170 (+50% bonus AD) (+75% AP) to 100 / 175 / 250 (+75% bonus AD) (+75% AP)
changes.note: Blurb: lost power to the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot meta; 'further encouraging crit builds'.

changes.name: Swain
details: Base Stats: Magic Resist 31 to 34
Base Stats: Armor 25 to 23
W - Vision of Empire: Cooldown 22 / 21 / 20 / 19 / 18s to 20 / 19 / 18 / 17 / 16s
changes.note: Blurb: 'moderate buff' for mid plus an 'adjustment' (MR up, armor down) to normalise mid vs bot.

changes.name: Tahm Kench
changes.note: Blurb: compensation for the 26.19 support item (World Atlas) regen change. Leaguepedia/wiki list the old value as 10/15/20/25/30; the official notes say 10/13.75/17.5/21.25/25 and are followed here.

changes.name: Vayne
changes.summary: Health regen 4 + 0.5/level to 5.5 + 0.4/level per 5s; Q mana cost 46/42/38/34/30 to 30 at all ranks
details: Base Stats: Health per 5 4 + .5/Level to 5.5 + .4/Level
Q - Tumble: Mana Cost 46 / 42 / 38 / 34 / 30 to 30
changes.note: Blurb uses 'adjusting her base stats' and 'reverting a mana cost'; both changes add power in lane (regen growth is marginally lower, 12.3 vs 12.5 at level 18), so recorded as buff.

changes.name: Yunara
changes.summary: Q passive on-hit damage 5/10/15/20/25 (+20% AP) to 3/8/13/18/23 (+20% AP); W slow no longer stacks with other slows
details: Q - Cultivation of Spirit: Passive On Hit Damage 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+20% AP) to 3 / 8 / 13 / 18 / 23 (+20% AP)
W - Arc of Judgement: Slow no longer stacks with other slows
changes.note: Blurb: 'leading candidate for handshake hyperscaler do nothing ... especially heading into worlds'.

changes.name: Experimental Hexplate
changes.summary: Ranged modifier 70% of value (35% attack speed, 14% move speed) to 50% of value (25% attack speed, 10% move speed)
details: Ranged Mod: 70% of Value (35% Attack Speed, 14% Move Speed) to 50% of Value (25% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed)
changes.note: Blurb: unhappy with ranged users, 'especially as a first rush in top lane'. Melee users unchanged.

changes.name: Hextech Rocketbelt
changes.summary: Ability haste 20 to 10; active damage 100 (+10% AP) to 135 (+15% AP)
details: Ability Haste: 20 to 10
Active Damage: 100 (+10% AP) to 135 (+15% AP)
changes.note: Blurb: 'pulling back on its generic value in favor of emphasizing aggressive action'. Net nerf for users who buy it as an escape (intro: 'a purchasable Flash'), buff for all-in AP bruisers.

changes.name: Runaan's Hurricane
changes.summary: Attack damage per bolt 65% to 60%
details: Attack Damage per Bolt: 65% to 60%
changes.note: Blurb: 'slightly overbuffed, so pulling back on that a bit'.

changes.name: Scoreboard item counters
changes.summary: Stack/icon counters hidden on the scoreboard for 15 items (Death's Dance, Haunting Guise, Liandry's Torment, Riftmaker, Kraken Slayer, Terminus, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Fiendhunter Bolts, Echoes of Helia, Dead Man's Plate, Spear of Shojin, Overlord's Bloodmail, Hullbreaker, Jak'sho the Protean, Force of Nature); Tear items and Mejai's still shown
details: Scoreboard Cleanup: icon counters hidden for Death's Dance, Haunting Guise, Liandry's Torment, Riftmaker, Kraken Slayer, Terminus, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Fiendhunter Bolts, Echoes of Helia, Dead Man's Plate, Spear of Shojin, Overlord's Bloodmail, Hullbreaker, Jak'sho the Protean, Force of Nature
Still shown: Tear of the Goddess items and Mejai's Soulstealer
changes.note: UI only, no balance effect; recorded because it is in the Items section.

bugfixes_pro_relevant: Shyvana: R Dragon's Descent now cancels enemy teleports (was not cancelling).
Sylas: stolen Nautilus Depth Charge (R) no longer fizzles after Sylas loses vision of the target.
Xin Zhao: Q no longer goes fully on cooldown if the first attack is dodged.
Orianna: R VFX and hitbox no longer misplace when cast before the ball reaches a fast-moving ally.
Sivir: Spell Shield now blocks Miss Fortune Q and Leona E correctly.
Kayle: Q no longer applies certain Spellblade item effects.
Malphite: Flash no longer disabled after using R.
Runaan's Hurricane: Volley no longer triggers minions' Call for Help.
Guinsoo's Rageblade: rapidly pressing Recall no longer gains stacks.
Large melee champions could auto-attack enemies outside immolate radius (fixed); immolate aura range now scales with bonus size.
patches.excluded: Classic mode (separate game mode) changes to Fiora, Graves, Fizz, Kennen, Nautilus and Classic items are not Summoner's Rift changes and are excluded. Planned Varus and Sylas changes reported in previews were pulled; neither appears in the notes (Sylas only in a bugfix).

patches.riot_intro: We're soon coming up on the Worlds patch (which is the patch after this one), so our first round of pro-focused Summoner's Rift changes are coming up here.

changes.name: Aatrox
changes.summary: W cooldown 20/18/16/14/12s to 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s; E heal ratio 1.1% to 1.3% per 100 bonus health
details: W - Infernal Chains: Cooldown 20 / 18 / 16 / 14 / 12 seconds to 18 / 16.5 / 15 / 13.5 / 12 seconds
E - Umbral Dash: Health Heal Ratio 1.1% per 100 bonus health to 1.3% per 100 bonus health
changes.note: Blurb: lost power with the Sundered Sky nerfs; keep him 'a world-ending threat'.

changes.name: Aphelios
changes.summary: Calibrum Moonshot damage 70-160 to 80-170; Severum healing 2-7.1% / 5-17.75% to 2-8% / 5-20%; Gravitum slow decays to 15% instead of 10%; Infernum Duskwave cooldown 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s to 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s; Crescendum mini-chakram 15% AD to 16% AD, minimum at 9th+ chakram instead of 8th+
details: Calibrum: Moonshot Damage 70 - 160 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP) to 80 - 170 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP)
Severum: Healing 2 - 7.1%, increased to 5 - 17.75% to 2 - 8%, increased to 5 - 20%
Gravitum: Slow 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 10% after 0.7 seconds to 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 15% after 0.7 seconds
Infernum: Duskwave Cooldown 9 / 8.25 / 7.5 / 6.75 / 6 seconds to 8 / 7.25 / 6.5 / 5.75 / 5 seconds
Crescendum: Mini-Crescendum Damage 15% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 8th+ chakram to 16% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 9th+ chakram
changes.note: Blurb: 'a little boost to encourage him to get out of his comfort zone'.

changes.name: Aurora
details: R - Between Worlds: Rift Duration 1.75 / 2.5 / 3.25 seconds to 2.25 / 2.75 / 3.25 seconds
changes.note: Blurb: fell off after Rocketbelt nerfs; 'a bit more power in her waveclear and outplay potential'. The LoL wiki also lists a Realm Hopper buff duration change (3.5/4.25/5 to 3.25/3.75/4.25) that is not in the official notes; not recorded.

changes.name: Draven
changes.summary: Base AD 62 to 64
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage 62 to 64
changes.note: Blurb: bot role-quest gold diluted Adoration; 'tapping up his early game damage'.

changes.name: Elise
changes.summary: Passive on-hit magic damage 12/22/32/42 to 14/24/34/44; W bonus attack speed 60/75/90/105/120% to 70/85/100/115/130%
details: Passive - Spider Queen: Passive Magic Damage On-Hit 12 / 22 / 32 / 42 to 14 / 24 / 34 / 44
W - Skittering Frenzy: Bonus Attack Speed 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120% to 70 / 85 / 100 / 115 / 130%
changes.note: Blurb: weak for a while; clear speed and damage.

changes.name: Fiora
changes.summary: Health growth 99 to 105; R heal range 550 to 600; R heal per tick 18.75/25/31.25 (+15% bonus AD) to 20/26.25/32.5 (+17.5% bonus AD); R max heal 375/500/625 (+300% bonus AD) to 400/525/650 (+350% bonus AD)
details: Base Stats: Health Growth 99 to 105
R - Grand Challenge: Heal Range 550 to 600
R - Grand Challenge: Heal Per Tick 18.75 / 25 / 31.25 (+15% bonus AD) to 20 / 26.25 / 32.5 (+17.5% bonus AD)
R - Grand Challenge: Maximum Heal 375 / 500 / 625 (+300% bonus AD) to 400 / 525 / 650 (+350% bonus AD)
changes.note: Blurb: 'room to shine a bit more' after a good start, without sharper 1v1 tools.

changes.name: Kha'Zix
changes.summary: Passive damage 17-136 to 22-141 (+50% bonus AD); evolved W slow 2s to 2.25s; evolved E range bonus +200 to +300
details: Passive - Unseen Threat: Damage 17 - 136 (+50% bonus AD) to 22 - 141 (+50% bonus AD)
W - Void Spike: Evolved Slow Duration 2 seconds to 2.25 seconds
E - Leap: Evolved Range Bonus +200 to +300
changes.note: Blurb: 'buff some of his weaker evolves'.

changes.name: Lillia
changes.summary: Base armor 22 to 24; R sleep duration 2s to 2.5s
details: Base Stats: Armor 22 to 24
R - Lilting Lullaby: Sleep Duration 2 seconds to 2.5 seconds
changes.note: Blurb: 'helping her durability' and making the lullaby more punishing. Buffed again in 26.20.

changes.name: Lucian
changes.summary: Passive Vigilance empowered on-hit damage 15 (+20% AD) to 5 (+15% AD); Q base damage 80/115/150/185/220 to 90/130/170/210/250 (+100% bonus AD unchanged)
details: Passive - Vigilance: Empowered On-Hit Damage 15 (+20% AD) to 5 (+15% AD)
Q - Piercing Light: Base Damage 80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 (+100% bonus AD) to 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 / 250 (+100% bonus AD)
changes.note: Blurb: 'adjust the tuning of the passive and strike a balance between both roles'. Riot's 26.20 notes say this 'landed as a nerf for bot lane'; bot Lucian was then buffed in 26.20.

changes.name: Master Yi
changes.summary: Q cooldown refund on hit -1 second scaling down with ability haste to flat 1 second
details: Q - Alpha Strike: Cooldown Refund on Hit -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste to 1 second
changes.note: Blurb: 'minimal impact on Summoner's Rift' (aimed at Mayhem and Arena).

changes.name: Nasus
details: Q - Siphoning Strike: Bonus Damage 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 to 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110
changes.note: Blurb: 'higher highs compensated with some lower lows ... more vulnerability early on'. Only one stat line in the notes.

changes.name: Nocturne
details: R - Paranoia: Cooldown 140 / 115 / 90 seconds to 160 / 130 / 100 seconds
changes.note: Blurb: 'a popular and powerful jungler in both pro and solo-queue'.

changes.name: Poppy
changes.summary: Q minion/monster max health cap 85/120/155/190/225 to 70/105/140/175/210
details: Q - Hammer Shock: Minion/Monster Maximum Health Cap 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 / 225 to 70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210
changes.note: Blurb: 'reverting a previous buff to jungle clear ... targeting her flexibility' as a counterpick.

changes.name: Rumble
changes.summary: Passive overheat attack speed 50-130% to 30-100%; passive monster cap 65-150 to 90-175
details: Passive - Junkyard Titan: Overheat Attack Speed 50 - 130% to 30 - 100%
Passive - Junkyard Titan: Monster Cap 65 - 150 to 90 - 175
changes.note: Blurb: 'continue to take over games' at high level; passive change 'much more elite-skewed, while giving Rumble in the Jungle some compensation'. Nerf for lane Rumble, partial compensation for jungle clear.

changes.name: Ryze
changes.summary: Armor growth 4.2 to 4.7; Q Flux bonus damage 25/50/75/100% to 15/40/65/90%; E mana cost 35/45/55/65/75 to 40/50/60/70/80
details: Base Stats: Armor Growth 4.2 to 4.7
Q - Overload: Flux Bonus Damage 25 / 50 / 75 / 100% increased damage to 15 / 40 / 65 / 90% increased damage
E - Spell Flux: Mana Cost 35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 to 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80
changes.note: Blurb: 'put some restraints on the archmage' (itemisation and roam strength) while helping bad solo queue matchups (armor growth up).

changes.name: Vi
changes.summary: Base AD 63 + 3.5/level to 61 + 3.9/level; passive shield 12% to 10% max health
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage 63 + 3.5/Level to 61 + 3.9/Level
Passive - Blast Shield: Shield 12% Maximum Health to 10% Maximum Health
changes.note: Blurb: less durability and early clear, 'a riskier pick who can still bring the pain'. AD growth up slightly compensates late.

changes.name: Volibear
changes.summary: Passive attack speed per stack 5% (+3% per 100 AP) to 5% (+4% per 100 AP); passive lightning on-hit damage gains +20% bonus AD
details: Passive - The Relentless Storm: Attack Speed per Stack 5% (+3% per 100 AP) to 5% (+4% per 100 AP)
Passive - The Relentless Storm: Lightning On-Hit Damage 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) to 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) (+20% bonus AD)
changes.note: Blurb: 'carefully buffing up AD Volibear ... tuning him up' across AD and AP builds.

changes.name: World Atlas
changes.summary: Health 30 to 0; base health regeneration 25% to 50%
details: World Atlas: Health 30 to 0
World Atlas: Health Regeneration 25% to 50%
changes.note: Support starting item. Blurb: melee supports too strong in roams/all-ins, too weak in sustained laning; flat health moved to regen (helps melee supports with higher base regen).

changes.name: Runic Compass
changes.summary: Health 100 to 60; base health regeneration 50% to 75%
details: Runic Compass: Health 100 to 60
Runic Compass: Health Regeneration 50% to 75%
changes.note: Support item second tier; notes list the line as World Atlas / Runic Compass / Bounty of Worlds: Health 30 / 100 / 200 to 0 / 60 / 200, Health Regeneration 25% / 50% / 75% to 50% / 75% / 75% (third tier unchanged).

changes.name: Teleport (top role quest)
changes.summary: Top role quest free Teleport cooldown 420s to 390s; top role quest upgraded Unleashed Teleport cooldown 330-240s to 300-210s; non-top Unleashed Teleport unchanged
details: Top Role Quest's Free Teleport Cooldown: 420 seconds to 390 seconds
Top Role Quest's Upgraded Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds to 300 - 210 seconds
Non-Top Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds to Unchanged
changes.note: Blurb: top lane 'slightly weak, especially for split pushing'; encourages side-lane pressure.

bugfixes_pro_relevant: Renekton: R now grants 20 Fury when cast immediately after W.
Camille: W no longer counts as two hits for Bone Plating; passive now procs Shield Bash reliably.
Yunara: basic attack resets now extend Hail of Blades properly.
Renata Glasc: R now amplifies damage caused by Berserk targets.
Taliyah: W terrain now matches its hitbox.
Yone: R warning VFX now visible in specific cases.
Nunu & Willump: can no longer unlock camera during W.
Clones now receive Homeguards after returning to fountain.
Aatrox: Q sweetspots use enhanced damage text instead of crit text.
patches.excluded: Classic mode and Arena champion/item changes excluded. Team Voice rollout postponed (no gameplay effect).

patches.riot_intro: Everything is where it belongs: Caps is in the Hall of Legends, Demacians are back in Classic, and ARAM Mayhem augments are on the right champions!

changes.name: Bard
changes.summary: Base armor 34 + 5/level to 32 + 4.7/level
details: Base Stats: Armor 34 + 5/Level to 32 + 4.7/Level
changes.note: Blurb: 'target his durability'; intro names Bard and Nautilus as 'overperforming pro supports'.

changes.name: Cassiopeia
changes.summary: Passive move speed 6-40% to 5-36%; Q damage 75/110/145/180/215 to 65/100/135/170/205, AP ratio 65% to 75%; E mana 40 to 45, base AP ratio 10% to 20%, enhanced AP ratio 55% to 45%, damage 52-120 to 50-120; R damage 150/250/350 to 125/225/325, AP ratio 50% to 75%
details: Passive - Serpentine Grace: Move Speed Bonus 6% - 40% (based on level) to 5% - 36% (based on level)
Q - Noxious Blast: Ability Power Ratio 65% to 75%
E - Twin Fang: Mana Cost 40 to 45
E - Twin Fang: Base Ability Power Ratio 10% to 20%
E - Twin Fang: Enhanced Ability Power Ratio 55% to 45%
E - Twin Fang: Total Ability Power Ratio 65% to 65% (unchanged)
E - Twin Fang: Damage 52 - 120 to 50 - 120
R - Petrifying Gaze: Damage 150 / 250 / 350 to 125 / 225 / 325
R - Petrifying Gaze: Ability Power Ratio 50% to 75%
changes.note: Blurb: reduce laning power in pro ('new heights of pro play dominance'), restore scaling, 'raising her floor'. Early-game nerf, late-game buff. The LoL wiki lists the E damage as 52-120 to 50-118; the official notes say 50-120 and are followed here. Further nerfed in 26.20.

changes.name: Ekko
changes.summary: Q mana cost 50/60/70/80/90 to 40/50/60/70/80; Q return damage AP ratio 60% to 70%
details: Q - Timewinder: Mana Cost 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 to 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80
Q - Timewinder: Return Damage Ability Power Ratio 60% to 70%
changes.note: Blurb: 'buffing' Ekko, especially mid, without touching Hail of Blades.

changes.name: Kassadin
changes.summary: Q AP ratio 70% to 80%; R base damage 70/90/110 to 80/95/110
details: Q - Null Sphere: Ability Power Ratio 70% AP to 80% AP
R - Riftwalk: Base Damage 70 / 90 / 110 to 80 / 95 / 110
changes.note: Blurb: has not recovered since earlier nerfs; 'more early agency' without touching late game.

changes.name: Master Yi
changes.summary: Armor growth 4.5 to 5 per level; R move speed 35/45/55% to 40/50/60%
details: Base Stats: Armor Growth 33 + 4.5/Level to 33 + 5/Level
R - Highlander: Move Speed 35 / 45 / 55% to 40 / 50 / 60%
changes.note: Blurb: 'buff up' after the Rageblade bugfix hit him; scales poorly as melee carry.

changes.name: Nautilus
changes.summary: Base AD 61 to 58 (+3.3/level unchanged); Q damage 85/130/175/220/265 to 85/125/165/205/245 (+90% AP unchanged)
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage 61 + 3.3/Level to 58 + 3.3/Level
changes.note: Blurb: 'nerfing' him after a year at the top of the meta; lockdown kept.

changes.name: Seraphine
changes.summary: E cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s to 11s at all ranks
details: E - Beat Drop: Cooldown 11 / 10.5 / 10 / 9.5 / 9s to 11s
changes.note: Blurb: targets bot-lane (E max) Seraphine; 'nerf' / 'nerfing'.

changes.name: Syndra
changes.summary: Passive splinter mana 20-255 to 20-199; W cooldown 12/11/10/9/8s to 13/12/11/10/9s
details: Passive - Transcendent: Splinter Mana 20 - 255 to 20 - 199
W - Force of Will: Cooldown 12 / 11 / 10 / 9 / 8s to 13 / 12 / 11 / 10 / 9s
changes.note: Blurb: 'nerfing' ('too performant', 'forefront of pro play'). The LoL wiki lists the old splinter mana as 20-215; the official notes say 20-255 and are followed here.

changes.name: Viego
changes.summary: AD growth 3.5 to 4; passive heal gains +2% per 500 bonus HP of target's max health
details: Base Stats: Attack Damage Growth 3.5 to 4
Passive - Sovereign's Domination: Heal 2% (+...) to 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) (+ 2% per 500 bonus HP) of the target's maximum health
changes.note: Blurb: win rate trending down; 'room to bring up' overall and the bruiser build. The old heal value is printed truncated in the official notes ('2% (+…. )'); the only new term is +2% per 500 bonus HP.

changes.name: Zaahen
changes.summary: Q2 damage 25/50/75/100/125 to 30/60/90/120/150 (+20/25/30/35/40% bonus AD unchanged); active Q now goes on cooldown immediately when entering Resurrection
details: Q - The Darkin Glaive: NEW Cooldown Behavior: If Q is active, it is now placed on Cooldown immediately upon being put in Resurrection
changes.note: Blurb: 'This might read as a nerf' but lets Q come back after resurrection; Q2 damage doubled relative to Q1.

changes.name: Zeri
changes.summary: W damage ratio 120% total AD to 100% total AD; W wall damage ratio 180% total AD to 150% total AD (bases unchanged)
details: W - Ultrashock Laser: Critical Strike 150% (+15% IE) (unchanged)
changes.note: Blurb: win rate up after recent buffs, 'showing up in pro'; 'pulling some power out of her burst' and waveclear.

changes.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
changes.summary: Seething Strike stack duration 3s to 4s
details: Seething Strike Stack Duration: 3s to 4s
changes.note: Blurb: 'minor QoL buff' compensating the double-hit timing bugfix.

changes.name: Baron Nashor Void Corruption
changes.summary: Bugfix: Baron Nashor's maximum Void Corruption stacks were higher than intended (lowered; no numbers given)
details: Fixed a bug where Baron Nashor's max stacks of Void Corruption was higher than intended.
changes.note: Objective change relevant to pro play; the notes give no before/after numbers.

bugfixes_pro_relevant: Teemo: traps now last their intended 10 minutes.
Akali: Q and R cast indicators match actual range; W can no longer be cast while moving.
Skarner: E heals its full amount.
Nidalee: Cougar E hit range and Human E cast range corrected.
